messages:
sam-sales: Kestrel Bank asks: EU-only residency for POC, BYOK (HSM), and no US subprocessors for processing or telemetry. Need quick runbook + delta pricing Hosted+BYOK vs Dedicated+HSM (30d POC, ~60 rps, ~300M tokens).

ravi-presales: Got it. Do they need Private VPC or is Dedicated w/ tenant pin sufficient? That changes PS scope.

emily-eng: Tenant_pin works for Hosted if we disable failover. For Dedicated/Private compute+storage remain in-region. Example routing_policy we propose: tenant_pin, region=eu-west-1, allow_cross_region_failover=false. Beware autoscale constraints.

paul-ops: Telemetry note: crash reporting uses a US service by default. For POC we can either disable crash reports, route traces/logs to customer's EU SIEM, or swap to EU provider. On-prem HSM peering requires VPN + CSR exchange. Est PS: 3-5 weeks.

claire-security: We can support BYOK with HSM keys in eu-west-1, key ops audited. Need to confirm support engineer access limits and log forwarding. We'll include audit controls in appendix.

mina-legal: We'll draft a subprocessor appendix limiting allowed vendors for the POC and include DPA/GDPR references. If they insist on zero-US supply-chain, some control plane elements may still be US-based; we'll flag those.

ravi-presales: Ballpark pricing: Hosted+BYOK: usage + BYOK fee ~$5k/mo + egress. Dedicated+HSM reserved: pool ~$28k/mo + HSM premium ~$7k/mo + PS. Exact quote after region & runbook locked.

sam-sales: Action items: emily export subproc inventory filtered to EU-only (Tue noon), paul publish EU-only POC runbook + HSM PS estimate (Wed EOD), ravi produce price comparison with assumptions (Wed COB), mina draft appendix (Thu). I'll update customer after inventory.

deploy-bot: deploy request created: #POC-9142 (eu-west-1 tenant_pin)
